items.title: Coding without AI: a revolutionary new way to work
items.raw_excerpt: A lot of teams procrastinate code review, phone it in, or get stuck in endless back-and-forth on every PR. Let’s talk about why. Myth #1 Myth: Code review is difficult because it’s boring and pull requests are too long. Instead of just accepting it as an unpleasant part of the job, we should ask why.

Fact: Code review is difficult because it duplicates the cognitive work of programming without all the intermediate steps. Engineers tend to dislike reviewing code. Instead of just accepting it as an unpleasant part of the job, we should ask why.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 很多团队拖延代码审查，敷衍了事，或者陷入每个拉取请求的无休止来回讨论。我们来谈谈原因。误区1：代码审查很难，因为它很无聊，而且拉取请求太长。

Based on this architecture, XOS 3.0 enables cross-embodiment skill transfer—capabilities learned once can be reused after changing the robot's form, truly achieving "one development, multiple form reuse." This overcomes key barriers that have long plagued the industry: high scenario migration costs and weak generalization ability.

items.raw_excerpt: 从最初的代码补全、函数生成，到围绕一个需求完成多文件修改、调试和测试，AI 在开发流程中的位置正在不断前移。今天的 Coding Agent，已经不再只是回答问题或生成片段，而是开始承担更完整的任务链路：理解需求、调研方案、生成代码、运行验证、修复问题，甚至完成代码评审。

title_i18n.zh: 从 Coding 到 Anything，Agent 正在重写工作流
title_i18n.en: From Coding to Anything, Agents are rewriting workflows.
title_i18n.es: De Coding a Anything, Agent está reescribiendo flujos de trabajo.

excerpt_i18n.zh: 从最初的代码补全、函数生成，到围绕一个需求完成多文件修改、调试和测试，AI 在开发流程中的位置正在不断前移。今天的 Coding Agent，已经不再只是回答问题或生成片段，而是开始承担更完整的任务链路：理解需求、调研方案、生成代码、运行验证、修复问题，甚至完成代码评审。
excerpt_i18n.en: From initial code completion and function generation to multi-file modification, debugging, and testing around a single requirement, AI's position in the development process is continuously moving forward. Today's Coding Agent is no longer just answering questions or generating snippets but is beginning to undertake more complete task chains: understanding requirements, researching solutions, generating code, running verification, fixing issues, and even performing code reviews.
excerpt_i18n.es: Desde la completación inicial de código y generación de funciones, hasta la realización de modificaciones en múltiples archivos, depuración y pruebas en torno a un requisito, la posición de la IA en el flujo de desarrollo se está moviendo cada vez más hacia adelante. El Coding Agent de hoy ya no solo responde preguntas o genera fragmentos, sino que comienza a asumir una cadena de tareas más completa: comprender requisitos, investigar soluciones, generar código, ejecutar validaciones, corregir problemas e incluso realizar revisiones de código.

excerpt_i18n.en: Over the past six years, domestic GPU companies have ridden the AI wave, with valuations constantly refreshed, while DPU has been overlooked. This does not align with industry reality. After Nvidia acquired Mellanox in 2020, it clearly defined its "GPU+CPU+DPU" three-chip strategy. In recent years, Nvidia has continued to strengthen its networking capabilities. When Jensen Huang showcased the "six-chip combination" at CES 2026, four of the chips were network-related. An increasingly clear trend is emerging: the bottleneck in AI infrastructure is shifting from computing power itself to networking and scheduling. Especially with the arrival of the Agent era, AI systems are transitioning from training to high-frequency inference and continuous operation, making GPU utilization increasingly dependent on network efficiency. The DPU has also evolved from an optional component in data centers to a key player in AI infrastructure. However, a thought-provoking question remains: since Nvidia had already bet on DPU, why did the entire industry still underestimate DPU over the past six years? It wasn't until the Shenzhen Stock Exchange accepted the IPO filing of Cloud Leopard Smart, the first domestic DPU company, and the prospectus was laid before everyone, that the market began to realize that a full-featured DPU capable of supporting low latency, high bandwidth, and high-performance data scheduling might be the most overlooked piece of the AI infrastructure puzzle. A large-chip track undervalued for six years. Over the past few years, the focus of competition in the AI industry has always been on GPU. Larger model parameters, stronger single-card performance, and more expensive HBM have almost captured the entire industry's attention.
excerpt_i18n.es: Durante los últimos seis años, las empresas nacionales de GPU han aprovechado la ola de la IA, con valoraciones que se actualizan constantemente, mientras que las DPU han sido ignoradas. Esto no se ajusta a la realidad industrial. Tras la adquisición de Mellanox por parte de NVIDIA en 2020, ya se definió la estrategia de «tres chips: GPU+CPU+DPU». En los últimos años, NVIDIA ha seguido reforzando sus capacidades de red, y cuando Jensen Huang presentó la «combinación de seis chips» en el CES 2026, cuatro de ellos estaban relacionados con la red. Una tendencia cada vez más clara empieza a aflorar: el cuello de botella de la infraestructura de IA está pasando de la propia potencia computacional a la red y la programación. Especialmente con la llegada de la era de los agentes, los sistemas de IA están pasando del entrenamiento a la inferencia de alta frecuencia.
